name: ai-quiet-hours-scheduler
description: Plan and protect quiet hours: React frontend + Python (FastAPI) backend with Claude AI.

scripts.setup: python -m pip install -r server/requirements.txt && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build && cd server && python -m app
scripts.test: python -m pytest server -q && npm test --prefix client
